name: Lily's Blast Off: A Lily's Time Off Fangame
source:
Lilypad Lily-chan is a ultra famous pop idol ultrallinare who is famous throughout the galaxy! So, it makes sense that she would have a concert in space for all of her alien fans (Thanks Megabro corp)! However, when she crashes into two idiotic aliens who just so happen to be her biggest fans, she ends up stranded on a planet with them. Will Holly and Mikey bring Lilypad Lily-chan to her concert?

[From [url=https://hypercandychan.itch.io/lilys-blast-off-a-lilys-time-off-fangame]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Lilypad Lily-chan是一位超级著名的流行偶像ultrallinare，在整个银河系都很有名！因此，她为所有外星粉丝举办一场太空音乐会是有道理的（感谢Megabro corp）！然而，当她撞上两个愚蠢的外星人，而他们恰好是她最大的粉丝时，她最终和他们一起被困在一个星球上。Holly和Mikey会带Lilypad Lily-chan来参加她的演唱会吗？

[来自[url=https://hypercandychan.itch.io/lilys-blast-off-a-lilys-time-off-fangame]itch.io[/url]]
